resolved_here: Unique 24-common-heavy-atom A/B correspondence with preserved R stereochemistry.
Source-name mapping from both published graphs to assembly1 ligand coordinates.
Complete export of selected 6032 existing heavy-atom coordinates in original angstrom strings and exact decimal nanometers.

evidence_review.finding: The primary aficamten structure paper deposits atomic model 9F6C. Its reported complex contains Mg/ADP/vanadate. A parameterized aficamten/compound17 RBFE system was not located in the reviewed availability statement.
evidence_review.boundary: The availability statement is not proof that no relevant parameter set exists elsewhere.

evidence_review.finding: Related OM/mavacamten cardiac-myosin simulations use CHARMM36m and build Mg/ADP/phosphate from a Mg/ADP/vanadate structure.
evidence_review.boundary: Those simulations concern different ligands and phosphate, not a validated aficamten/compound17 vanadate model.

evidence_review.finding: Related OM simulations model missing loops, replace vanadate with H2PO4, convert trimethyllysine to lysine, and use AMBER ff14SB. Their trajectories are described as available upon request.
evidence_review.boundary: These substitutions cannot silently preserve ORVIA-001 deposited chemistry; the reported trajectory availability is not an open downloadable prepared ORVIA input.

evidence_review.finding: Forcefield_PTM supplies published trimethyllysine parameters compatible with AMBER ff03, among other modifications.
evidence_review.boundary: Availability of a residue parameter set does not establish compatibility with a different chosen protein force field or validate the assembled myosin system.

evidence_review.finding: The force-field authors distribute versioned CHARMM topology and parameter files.
evidence_review.boundary: No CHARMM release is silently adopted here; complete topology/parameter coverage, functional forms and license/provenance must be pinned before export.

search_scope: Primary aficamten structure/discovery evidence and their availability statements.
Related published cardiac-myosin molecular dynamics preparations.
Published trimethyllysine force fields and original force-field distribution.

scientific_input_blockers.required: Explicit reviewed model for 65 missing residues, TRP130 CG and termini, retaining provenance and validation for all introduced coordinates.
Declared vanadate species/charge/coordination and compatible Mg/ADP/vanadate parameters with validation. No silent phosphate substitution or free vanadium-ion analogy.
Exact compatible protein/M3L/ligand/cofactor/water/ion force-field files and charges, all bonded terms/exceptions and supported functional forms; independent energy/force comparisons.
Simulation microstates, explicit hydrogens and their map, parameterized A/B endpoints, compound17 pose validation, hybrid topology and soft-core specification.
Complete complex and solvent legs with registered water/ion model, box, concentrations, temperature, pressure and canonical atom order.

Registered minimization/equilibration, lambda states, repeats/seeds, sample retention, overlap/decorrelation/uncertainty and failure/extension criteria; engine must implement every selected operation.

experimental_claim_limit.note: A research model can report its prediction with model uncertainty; functional ATPase IC50 cannot be relabeled Kd. Mainnet deployment alone cannot establish biological validity.

engineering_and_chain_readiness: Owned by the deployment/engine readiness reports; this audit cannot clear those gates.
